nodes.description: Public payable transfer(address,uint) that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as _from.
Public payable transferFrom(address,address,uint) that mutates balanceOf, allowance and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure().
Internal view whitelist check granting bypass to owner, UNI, pair token, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition().
Public payable approve(address,uint) that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sales-limit check reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied address and calldata.
Privileged mint function callable by owner or a hardcoded address that overwrites balanceOf and sets canSale.
Owner-only initializer that sets _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution that loops over _tos with unchecked total arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using keccak256 of factory, tokens and init code hash.
Payable constructor that sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and infinite allowance for the router.
Public mapping of token balances mutated by transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested mapping of allowances written by approve, transferFrom and the constructor.
Private owner address used as the access-control root and whitelist bypass.
Private mapping counting sale actions per address, used by condition().
Private mapping of addresses whitelisted for sale, set by _mints and read by ensure().
Private minimum sale amount configured by init().
Private maximum sale amount configured by init().
Private per-address sale count limit configured by init() and read by condition().
Whitelisted trading address set by setTradeAddress and read by ensure().
Public total supply set in the constructor.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for authorization and identity throughout the contract.
Delegatecall to an attacker controlled address with attacker controlled calldata in delegate().
Unchecked subtraction/addition of balanceOf without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Arbitrary balance overwrite in _mints guarded only by owner or a hardcoded EOA address.
Unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication and balance mutation loop in batchSend.
_from address parameter of transferFrom.
_to address parameter of transferFrom.
_value amount parameter of transferFrom.
_to address parameter of transfer.
spender address parameter of _mints.
addedValue amount parameter of _mints.
a address parameter of delegate, target of the delegatecall.
b bytes parameter of delegate, calldata for the delegatecall.
_tos address array parameter of batchSend.
saleNum parameter of init.
token parameter of init used for _minSale.
maxToken parameter of init used for _maxSale.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress.
local total computed as _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
local _UNI pair address computed via pairFor in ensure.
loop index i in batchSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of transferFrom inside transfer.
msg.sender decides the allowance branch and is compared against _from in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in approve.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before an arbitrary delegatecall.
_mints authorizes minting based on msg.sender being owner or a hardcoded address.
init requires msg.sender == owner to configure sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass balance transfers.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner to set the whitelist slot.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
_from parameter flows into balance, allowance and whitelist checks in transferFrom.
_to parameter flows into ensure and balanceOf credit in transferFrom.
_value parameter flows into allowance, ensure and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
transfer forwards its _to parameter into transferFrom.
spender parameter determines the balanceOf key overwritten in _mints.
addedValue parameter directly sets the minted balance in _mints.
address a is the delegatecall target in delegate.
bytes b is the delegatecall calldata in delegate.
_tos array is iterated and credited inside batchSend.
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum in init.
token parameter is scaled and stored into _minSale in init.
maxToken parameter is scaled and stored into _maxSale in init.
addr parameter is written into tradeAddress.
local total uses unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication in batchSend.
local _UNI pair address participates in the whitelist comparison in ensure.
loop index i drives the unchecked balance credit loop in batchSend.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom requires ensure() to succeed before state changes.
ensure falls through to require(condition(...)) for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure computes the pair address through pairFor.
transferFrom decrements and credits balanceOf without SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue * 10**decimals.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true.
init sets _minSale from token.
init sets _maxSale from maxToken.
init sets _saleNum from saleNum.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
batchSend subtracts total from and credits balanceOf in an unchecked loop.
condition reads _saleNum to derive the per-address limit.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against the sale limit.
condition enforces the _minSale threshold.
condition enforces the _maxSale threshold.
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure grants a bypass when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure grants a bypass when canSale[_from] is true.
constructor assigns the owner state variable from msg.sender.
constructor seeds balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
constructor grants infinite allowance to the router address.
constructor sets totalSupply.
delegate() performs a delegatecall into externally supplied code that executes in this contract's storage context.
transferFrom mutates balances with raw -= and += operations.
_mints performs unconstrained minting behind a weak authorization check.
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and repeated balance credits.
